title: Notitia Dignitatum (Eastern and Western parts) / List of Offices / RU: «Notitia dignitatum» (Перечень должностей)
author: Anonymous (office of the primicerius notariorum)
genre: Register of administrative and military posts, with illustrations
size: East 43 chapters, West 45 chapters; est. 15–20k words, mostly lists
edition: Seeck 1876, public domain: https://archive.org/details/notitiadignitat00seecgoog. Neira Faleiro, Madrid 2005
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia (Notitia dignitatum) lists editions and studies but no translation. Absent from the vostlit, ancientrome and simposium catalogues.
en_evidence: Fairley, Notitia Dignitatum or Register of Dignitaries (University of Pennsylvania 1899; Open Library). Dated and without commentary.
value: Fundamental for late Roman army units, the civil administration, state arms factories (fabricae) and frontier commands; a standard reference for military historians and archaeologists of the frontier (limes). A Russian version with commentary on the units would be widely used.
ai_feasibility: high for the text (lists); medium for the commentary (identifying units, insignia, archaeology).
pilot_unit: East, chs. I–IX (prefects and magistri militum with their unit lists; est. 4–5k words)
